faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits Dell Latitude 14 E5450, Latitude 15 E5550, Latitude 12 E5250, and Latitude 3150/3160. It does not fit the E5470, E5570 or E5270 refresh models, which use a different battery. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
